title: Media Graph App Drop Preview and Create
description:
Drag and drop of apps into the media graph should preview the node and create it. Currently there is no preview and when finished nothing happens.

Root cause (WGPU/native s path): catalogue MIME application/x-semio-catalogue-item is not handled for ghost preview (node_graph_sync_flow_widget_ghost only accepts x-flow-widget) and finish_tree_drag only spawns on World3d/Window hits, never the node-graph ScrollRegion surface. Mirror React FlowGraphCanvasHost behaviour: ghost via set_ghost_widget during drag-over, spawnApp with world coords on drop over node_graph_states.
summary: Fixed WGPU media-graph catalogue drag-and-drop so apps preview as a ghost node and spawn on drop. Root cause: ghost sync only handled application/x-flow-widget (catalogue MIME cleared the ghost), and finish_tree_drag only spawned on World3d/Window hits while the graph surface is ScrollRegion. Now catalogue MIME builds a neuron ghost during drag-over node_graph_states, and drop dispatches spawnApp with surface controller + world coords (mirroring React FlowGraphCanvasHost). React catalogue routing tests: 12 passed. New WGPU unit tests added; full wgpu lib-test compile currently blocked by unrelated UiPresence migration elsewhere in the same crate (0 errors in the changed regions).
